items.title: More than 220,000 evacuated in France and Spain due to wildfires
items.description: French firefighters battle a blaze heading towards Bordeaux while officials in Madrid say they face the "worst fire in the history of the region".

items.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
items.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

items.title: Zelensky tries to fix crisis over removal of defence minister and counts the cost
items.description: Protests have continued over Zelensky's decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, and some commentators believe he has been damaged politically.

items.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
items.description: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.

items.title: Texts reveal 14-year-old allegedly murdered by singer D4vd had pregnancy and abortion
items.description: Prosecutors allege D4vd started abusing the girl when she was 13 and she had threatened to expose him.

items.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
items.description: US military says it disabled a tanker that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.

items.title: Trump vows to investigate EU over fining of US tech companies
items.description: The US president says fines against Google, as well as Apple, Meta and Amazon, should be "entirely reversed."

items.title: ICC top prosecutor removed over sexual misconduct allegations
items.description: Karim Khan denies allegations of engaging in an improper sexual relationship with a junior ICC staff member and seeking to stop her pursuing her complaint.

items.title: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
items.description: The event celebrated press freedom after the first dinner was cancelled by a shooting in April.

items.title: Trump orders Smithsonian to post warnings about 'inaccurate' US history
items.description: The Trump administration has often accused the world's largest research museum of harbouring an anti-American bias.

items.title: US hits dozens of countries with new wave of tariffs
items.description: Imposed citing forced labour concerns, the levies replace a temporary global duty brought in after the US Supreme Court struck down tariffs in February.

items.title: Nigeria's president approves largest military expansion in recent times
items.description: The government is under intense pressure to tackle a slew of armed groups, many of whom attack civilians.
